text: A k=16 Factorization Machine trained with Adam at lr=0.001 on user_id, video_id, author_id, tab, and duration_bucket reproduces the official baseline within seed noise: primary 0.6034 versus 0.6016, a difference of 0.0018, so it is a valid reference but not a demonstrated improvement.

Adding the tested DeepFM over informative categorical fields while retaining the FM signal produces no measurable improvement over the five-field FM reference: primary changed from 0.6034 to 0.6047, a gain of 0.0013 within seed noise.

In the tested configuration, leakage-free Bayesian leave-one-out entity and user-context affinity features do not make a competitive pointwise LightGBM ranker: its standalone primary was 0.4917, validation-selected user-rank blending assigned it zero weight, and the resulting incumbent change was only about 0.0002.

The tested empirical-Bayes post-model residual corrections do not measurably improve within-user ranking over the incumbent: the best correction used all-time tab residuals at weight 0.2 and changed primary from 0.6049317 to 0.6050449, a gain of 0.000113 within seed noise.

Direct residual personalization by sparse content identifiers has very limited validation/test applicability in this split: train-known coverage is only 3.38%/2.56% for author_id and 1.62%/1.30% for video_id, while the selected tab field has 93.31%/89.58% coverage but still yields no measurable gain.

The tested low-rank DCN-V2 reranker over 18 categorical and 5 numeric fields does not measurably improve the incumbent: its best validation-selected blend changed primary from 0.6050449 to 0.6053008, a gain of only 0.000256 within seed noise.

The tested DCN-V2 is not competitive as a standalone replacement for the incumbent: its best raw primary was 0.6022171 versus the incumbent's 0.6050449, and the selected result required blending with the incumbent at DCN-V2 weight 0.65.

For the tested DCN-V2 training setup, the first epoch was best for both raw and blended validation ranking; continued optimization reduced raw primary from 0.6022171 at epoch 1 to 0.6000799 at epoch 4 despite decreasing training loss.
